cascader.optionsNote: The probe did not open these menus. The only captured display token is valueSample 北京. The offline menu leaf is that token so an empty control can read it back. No other city text was captured for these rows.

livePair.note: Page text shows the value twice (北京 北京), the same shape as 现居住地 (北京市 北京市). Accept two .ant-select nodes only when both displays match and are non-empty. A different display, a hidden or disabled twin, allow-clear, or any count other than 1 or 2 fails closed.
